summary: Applied one authorization projection across DAV discovery/reads/reports/writes: free-busy viewers now receive busy placeholders (no private fields) on GET/query/multiget, and imported external-feed events reject PUT/DELETE with 404 while remaining readable.
follow_up: event_is_imported uses unwrap_or(false) on DB error; the domain ensure_not_imported provides defense-in-depth, but the DAV pre-check could propagate the error for stricter fail-closed behavior
manager role is not explicitly tested (same permission class as editor, covered by the same code paths)
important_context: Free-busy representation omits SUMMARY/DESCRIPTION/LOCATION/STATUS, exposing only DTSTART/DTEND, matching the domain EventAccess::FreeBusy projection
Imported = event has a row in external_event_mapping; DAV PUT/DELETE on them returns 404 (empty body) consistent with the DAV denial convention of hiding existence
Denial code for role-based and imported write rejections is 404 Not Found with empty body, matching existing DAV denial tests
